name: @holoscript/holosystem
description: Portable bootstrap, consumption catalog, lineage, and bounded-work contract for HoloSystem consumers.

scripts.build: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/catalog.mjs && node --check bin/holosystem.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke

publicConsumption.coreRule: Cold consumers create and inspect configuration, discover unlike public rails separately, map source lineage, and select bounded next work from caller-owned evidence.
publicConsumption.localBoundary: Machine paths, credentials, private repositories, and operator state are caller inputs, never package defaults.
publicConsumption.supportBoundary: Configuration, public discovery, lineage, and bounded selection are supported; installation, credential acquisition, board mutation, service mutation, spending, and publishing remain caller-authorized operations.
